name: crg-task-dashboard
description: BSI CRG Task & Project Monitoring Dashboard (NestJS backend + React frontend)

scripts.setup:unix: node scripts/init-env.mjs && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run setup --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
